name: Landslide4Sense
description: A benchmark dataset for landslide detection consisting of 3,799 satellite image patches combining Sentinel-2 optical imagery with elevation and slope data, with pixel-level landslide labels.
citation: Ghorbanzadeh, O., Xu, Y., Ghamisi, P., Kopp, M., & Kreil, D. (2022). Landslide4Sense: Reference Benchmark Data and Deep Learning Models for Landslide Detection. IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing, 60, 1–17. https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2022.3215209

license.notes: The dataset license is unverified; no license terms were identified in the available source information.
